title: Spacehuhn - SAO++ edition
credit: Original design: davedarko (Dave Darko), retro Spacehuhn badge rev3, github.com/davedarko/Simple-Add-ons-SAO. Spacehuhn logo: Spacehuhn (Stefan Kremser)
notes: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.
The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.
LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
D1 = the chicken's front eye, D2 = its back eye, at the maker's two LED centres. The maker's rev3 had two 5 mm self-cycling RGB LEDs straight on the cell, no resistor.
One 1.3k resistor per white LED: about 0.45 mA each on badge power, about 0.2 mA each on a fresh cell.
